svg.title: Chatbot evaluation and improvement loop
svg.desc: A frozen gold set, multi-turn conversations and retrieval metrics are run on each local model, recording every tool call and result. The harness flags invented citations and unverified figures; each flag is read by hand against the tool data. The cause found was that every invented citation came from an answer that never searched. Fixes went into code, were replayed on the recorded answers, then run live. The LLM judge was checked against the known inventions and failed, so other judges are being tested.
